scope: The local owner signature store CLI and synthetic definition stores on macOS.

reporting.deleted: The generation directory was removed during the operation. The directory_synced field records confirmation of the deletion's durability.
reporting.directory_synced: The parent directory sync after removal of the generation and any lease file is confirmed.
reporting.lease_removed: The lease file was removed or was already absent.
reporting.history_updated: In a partial response, false when the update was skipped for incomplete cleanup or cannot be confirmed, and null when there was no matching history entry to remove.
reporting.history_preservation: Cleanup must be confirmed before attempting to prune the publication record. A failure after replacing the reference may leave the new history visible, with durability unconfirmed. The result asks the owner to list the store again.

regressions.baseline_check: The parent sync fault test failed on the base behavior with the generic maintenance error after generation removal.
cases: A parent directory sync fault after generation and lease removal reports partial and the deleted ID, with sync and history update unconfirmed. The wait and publication reference are retained.
A failed lease unlink reports partial and the deleted ID, confirms the successful parent sync, keeps the lease file and reference, and releases the lease lock.
When the generation directory removal fails, the command takes the error path. The directory, lease and publication reference remain, with no deleted ID.
A parent sync fault during the later publication history rewrite reports history unconfirmed even if the new reference is already visible.
Existing busy publication lock and history write failure regressions still report the deleted ID. The busy case confirms completed parent sync and lease cleanup.

verification.android_command: env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv-dev/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_android.py -q
verification.mcp_command: env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv-dev/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_mcp.py -q
verification.python_skip_reason: All 17 skipped tests require Windows. Both runs included Android and real MCP SDK tests.

limits: I/O faults were injected in synthetic stores. Power interruption and real filesystem failure were outside this run.
No existing definition store, retained container or wait state was used.

findings: After a failed lease unlink, the listing showed neither the leftover lease file nor the deleted ID, and a later publication kept the history entry while the lease remained. Reproduced in a synthetic store: after the lease was removed by hand, the pruning removed the entry.
The documentation no longer said that a later publication removes a remaining history entry and that generation deletion may stay held until then.
A stage deletion whose parent directory sync failed still raised the generic maintenance error without the deleted ID.
changes: README and design notes tell the owner to remove a leftover lease file by hand and say when a later publication removes a remaining history entry.
A stage deletion with an unconfirmed parent directory sync reports partial with the deleted ID and directory_synced false.
review_follow_up.regression: The new stage sync fault test failed on the reviewed commit with the generic maintenance error and passes after the change.

verification.npm: Not rerun: no JavaScript or packaging file changed.
